title: Gate Token
description: Frozen v1 contract for gate-decision authorization tokens (JWT claim set). See spec.md for signing-algorithm allowlist and rejection rules.

sub.description: Subject the token authorizes (agent_run_id or actor id).

exp.description: Expiry (Unix seconds). Bounds token validity — required for replay/window control.

jti.description: Unique token id — single-use/replay-prevention claim. A consuming resource server MUST track seen jti values within the token's validity window and reject reuse.

gate_decision_id.description: FK to Vault gate_decisions.id — binds this token to the specific gate decision and resource it authorizes, so it cannot be replayed against a different resource/decision.

resource.description: Optional additional resource-binding hint (e.g. campaign_id or asset_id) narrowing what gate_decision_id authorizes.
